Oven Spaghetti and Meat
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 8, 2009 - 11:23pm

Ingredients




2 tablespoons Oil
1 pound Ground beef
1 small Onion, minced
1 cup Ketchup
1 1/2 cups Tomato juice
1 teaspoon Salt
1/4 teaspoon Pepper
1 cup Broken, uncooked spaghetti
Grated cheese (optional)

Preparation

1 Brown meat and onions in skillet until meat loses its red color. Add remaining ingredients in order listed, except cheese. Stir to blend. Place in casserole and bake covered at 375 for 1 to 1-1/2 hours. Sprinkle with cheese when done.
